breeding.title: Breeding and lambing
breeding.description: Pregnancies, lambing calendar, breeding results and pedigree

pregnancies.addHint: The expected lambing date is calculated automatically.
pregnancies.bulkTitle: Record pregnancy for a whole herd
pregnancies.bulkHint: Records every ewe in the herd with the same date. Ewes already pregnant are skipped.
pregnancies.bulkInbreeding_one: {{count}} ewe is related to the ram, please check
pregnancies.bulkInbreeding_other: {{count}} ewes are related to the ram, please check
pregnancies.closeHint: Choose the outcome. The ewe returns to active.
pregnancies.deleteBody: The record for ewe {{tag}} will be removed. Use this only for a record entered by mistake.
pregnancies.editHint: Changing the date recalculates the lambing date.
pregnancies.emptyBody: Add a pregnancy, or record a whole herd at once.
pregnancies.inbreedingBody: This ewe and ram share an ancestor: {{tags}}. You can still save, but please check.

calendar.byWeekHint: How many ewes are due each week. Plan feed and labour around it.
calendar.empty: No lambing expected in the next 6 months
calendar.expectedLambsHint: Estimate: {{perEwe}} lambs per ewe. The real figure comes after the first lambings
calendar.overdueHint: Past the latest date with no lambing recorded
calendar.scannedHint: By scan: {{ewes}} ewes carry {{fetuses}} lambs. The rest are counted as before.

lambing.tooEarly: This date is well before the expected lambing (earliest {{date}}). Check the date. If she aborted, mark the lambs "Stillborn" or close the pregnancy with "Did not lamb".
lambing.needSex: Choose the sex of each lamb
lambing.emptyBody: The first lambing will appear here.

kpis.emptyBody: Each ewe's results appear here once lambings are recorded.

rams.explain: Rams are rated by how fast their lambs grow. 100 is the farm average; 110 is 10% faster than average.
rams.emptyBody: The rating appears once rams are registered and their lambs weighed.

pedigree.truncated: There are many descendants; showing the first 200.
pedigree.emptyBody: Find an animal by its tag and its pedigree appears here.

health.title: Veterinary
health.description: Vaccination, treatment, quarantine and withdrawal periods

today.allClearBody: No sick reports and no overdue vaccinations.

journal.warehouseHint: Leave empty to use the drug's main warehouse
journal.qtyUsedHint: Leave empty to use dose × head × days
journal.withdrawalHint: Leave empty to use the drug's default
journal.headCountHint: Leave empty to use the herd size
journal.editStockNote: Saving recalculates what was taken from stock.
journal.emptyBody: Vaccinations, treatments and examinations are kept here.

vaccinations.vaccineHint: Leave empty to use the plan's product
vaccinations.qtyHint: Leave empty to use dose × head count
vaccinations.head: Head
vaccinations.emptyBody: Everything is up to date for this period.

plans.title: Vaccination plans
plans.hint: A plan works out when vaccination is due from age and interval.
plans.name: Name
plans.itemHint: Records using this vaccine count towards the plan
plans.deleteBody: "{{name}}" leaves the calendar. Past records are kept.
plans.emptyBody: Add the mandatory vaccinations and the calendar builds itself.

quarantine.addHint: For newly arrived or sick animals.
quarantine.daysHint: Leave empty to use the farm setting
quarantine.emptyBody: Put new or sick animals into quarantine here.

withdrawal.explain: Meat and milk from these animals cannot be sold before the date shown.
withdrawal.emptyBody: An animal given a drug with a withdrawal period appears here.

sick.reportHint: The vet is told straight away.
sick.unreportedHint: Marked as sick on the animal card.
sick.resolveHint: The report closes and the animal returns to its earlier status.

documents.name: Name
documents.emptyBody: Veterinary and quarantine certificates are kept here.

scan.zeroHint: 0 means empty: the pregnancy is closed and the ewe is open again. Tap a number again to clear it.
scan.noMatch: No pregnant ewe with this tag in the herd
scan.narrow: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}}. Search by tag to narrow the list.
scan.emptyConfirmBody: Their pregnancies will be closed as not pregnant, and they will show as open again.
scan.chooseHerd: Choose a herd to enter a scanning day.

skipped.SCAN_BEFORE_MATING: the scan date is before mating

scan.emptyBody: Ewes appear here once a pregnancy is recorded.

desk.watchHint: Ewes due within {{n}} days and overdue ones, soonest first
desk.watchEmptyBody: No ewe is due in the next {{n}} days, and none is overdue.
desk.attentionHint: No colostrum on record {{hours}} hours after birth, and lambs on the bottle. The hours are a starting value.
desk.attentionEmptyBody: Every newborn has colostrum on record, and none is on the bottle.

care.title: Newborn care: {{tag}}
care.fosterHint: The dam stays in the pedigree. The foster ewe only raises the lamb.
care.afterHint: Enter colostrum and the navel for each lamb, and put the ewe in a pen.

pens.title: Lambing pens
pens.putInHint: The ewe goes in with her newborn lambs.
pens.releaseBody: The ewe and her lambs leave pen {{pen}}, and it becomes free.
pens.chooseHint: Switch on the barn sections that serve as lambing pens.
pens.noSectionsBody: A lambing pen is a section of a barn. Add sections to a barn first.
pens.emptyBody: Choose which barn sections are lambing pens.
pens.emptyBodyReader: No barn section is marked as a lambing pen yet.

condition.sameDayHint: A second score on the same day replaces the first.
condition.scaleHint: Scored by hand over the loin, from 1 (very thin) to 5 (very fat) in half steps. No target score is given here: a fat-tailed sheep carries much of its fat in the tail, so judge your flock against its own earlier scores.
condition.chooseHerd: Choose a herd to enter a scoring day.
condition.noMatch: No animal with this tag in the herd

stats.head: Animals
stats.averageHint: latest scores, no older than {{days}} days

condition.emptyBody: This herd has no animals on the farm.

fatTail.title: Fat-tail measurements
fatTail.hint: Give at least one measurement, in centimetres.

grading.title: Grading
grading.hint: The classes are the farm's own list, not an official standard.

score.title: Ewe score
score.open: Score of {{tag}}: {{score}}. Show how it is made
score.none: No lambing on record, so there is no score yet.
score.listHint: The score runs from 0 to 100 and is built from the ewe's own records. Tap a score to see its parts.

fact.rearing: She reared {{value}} of her lambs to weaning. A lamb fostered away or bottle-fed is not counted as reared by her.
fact.lamb_growth: Her lambs' weight at 100 days is {{value}} of the farm average.

score.missingBody: These parts are left out, and the others carry their share.
score.startingValues: The weights and scales are starting values chosen for this product, not figures from a book.

culling.markHint: This is your own decision. It does not remove the animal or record a sale.
culling.clearBody: The mark stays in the history as closed.
culling.explain: The list below is worked out from records. Its thresholds are starting values chosen for this product. It only suggests: a person decides and marks the animal.
culling.markedEmptyBody: An animal you mark for culling appears here.
culling.suggestedHint: A marked animal moves to the list above.
culling.suggestedEmptyBody: No ewe crosses any of the lines on her records.

why.empty_twice: Mated and found empty {{seasons}} seasons running
why.no_lamb_reared: No lamb reared in her last {{lambings}} lambings
why.low_score: Score among the lowest {{share}} of the flock
why.thin_twice: Thin (score {{score}} or below) at her last {{scorings}} scorings

errors.VACCINE_REQUIRED: Choose the plan or the product

errors.CLEARED_BEFORE_MARKED: The mark cannot be cleared before the day it was made
